description: This file contains automated tests for Android WebView functionality using Playwright testing framework. It includes tests for launching WebViews, navigating pages, fetching pages, and cookie handling.

methods.name: test('androidDevice.webView')
methods.description: Tests launching a WebView on an Android device and verifies web view count and package name.

methods.name: test('webView.page')
methods.description: Tests retrieving a page from a WebView and verifies the URL.

methods.name: test('should navigate page internally')
methods.description: Tests internal navigation of a WebView page.

methods.name: test('should navigate page externally')
methods.description: Tests external navigation of a WebView page via URL input.

methods.name: test('select webview from socketName')
methods.description: Tests connecting to an existing WebView via socket name and verifies page properties.

methods.name: test.fail('should be able to receive webView cookies')
methods.description: Tests retrieving cookies from a WebView, marking the test as expected to fail due to WebView version requirements.
